column1: # DRAGON BALL: Sparking! ZERO: Spike Chunsoft / Bandai Namco on Unreal Engine 5.1.1 (IoStore, every pak and container encrypted, MallocBinned3), SDK 14.3.0, NVN, CRIWARE sound and movies;
# update 2.0.76 (v327680) over the base game, with its six add-on contents.
# Started from the NSP script's provisional profile (dm/games/profile_guess.py) and brought up on the Mac (docs/agents)

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# Octopath Traveler 0's block: 3.2 GB of alias region, which the engine region gets nearly all of (dm/tools/ue_region.py). With FMallocBinned3 cut (dm/tools/ue_malloc.py, both of its calls)
# the engine region's page allocator reached +0.50 GB through the tutorial battle on the Mac; Unreal's heap is the host's (1.25 GB there)
# the NPDM declares 30 MB of system resource
# 60 fps (30 on the Switch): the host writes rhi.SyncInterval 1 and GEngine->FixedFrameRate 60 (dm/tools/ue_fixed_rate.py), which the engine steps the battles by; see the note's Frame rate
# 120 on the Mac when chosen: under test (the note's Frame rate)
# a 3D arena whose camera follows the fight, many buttons (D-pad, both sticks)
# shaders inline in the cooked packages (labels: <pak or container>#<package path>): the engine's global shader cache, the engine's and the game's packages
# the game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode with near = 0 (the NSP script's address region check): the pipeline bases made before it runs are made for that mode
